description: This file defines the API routes for managing 'Project' entities in a portfolio dashboard. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting projects, with access control based on user roles and project status. It also employs SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions and Pydantic models for data validation.
